_bybit_sub_activation_steps: 1. Log into Bybit master account → Account & Security → Sub Accounts → Create Sub Account
Name: crypto-lab-k485-sub1 | Type: Standard Sub Account | Permissions: Trade (no Withdrawal)
2. In sub-account: API → Create API Key
Scope: Read (positions/balance) + Trade (order place/cancel). NO Withdraw scope.
Set IP whitelist (optional, recommended if server has fixed IP).
3. Paste credentials into .env.local (NOT committed to repo):
7. Fund sub-account: Bybit Asset Center → Internal Transfer → main→sub ($2-5M USDT)
8. Activate live routing: bybit_multi_account_client.py detects BYBIT_SUB_API_KEY automatically
=== Reversibility: unset BYBIT_SUB_API_KEY → all routing returns to main ===

_bybit_sub_compliance.basis: Bybit ToS permits sub-accounts under same master KYC for risk separation. NOT a duplicate personal account.
_bybit_sub_compliance.kyc_requirement: Same master account KYC applies. No additional KYC for sub-accounts.
_bybit_sub_compliance.withdrawal_scope: DISABLED — sub API key must NOT have withdraw permission
